name: Dungeon Stake: Arcade
description: Football, Ice Hockey, and 1v1 Dungeon Fighters with free play and optional NEAR Testnet escrow for friend rooms.
problem: Friends can start a competitive match without assembling two full teams. CPU players fill empty sports seats while human winners can share a Testnet stake.
userFlow: Run npm ci and npm run dev, then open http://localhost:3000.
Choose a game and a character. Create a room or join with an invite code.
For team games, invite friends and have the host balance the teams and fill the open seats with bots. Every human readies up.
Use a free room or configure the Testnet escrow using the README. In a staked room every human confirms the same deposit, and human winners can withdraw their split.
